description: One-call profile of a département: installed capacity and national rank, yearly trend (by first-seen imagery year), source mix, share identified by 2+ sources, and share matched to an RNB building id. Cross-references the pre-computed department statistics with live counts. Data quality note: this is a detection dataset, not an exhaustive inventory (estimated recall ~0.6). A missing detection does not mean no PV installation exists there. kwp, surface, tilt and azimuth are model estimates, not surveyed values. In this server, quality_filter=true keeps only detections identified by 2 or more sources (see source_encoding in get_data_quality_reference). Call get_data_quality_reference for the full picture before assessing fitness for a specific use case.
name: get_department_profile
